QuestInfo.name: Hat Trick
QuestInfo.0: Let Tina know that Blake doesn't like the wig either.
QuestInfo.1: Tina is at her wit's end. She's willing to try a hat, any hat, just to get this over with. Get the hats off the Male Mannequins.
QuestInfo.2: Blake's willing to wear the hat. Progress!

0.0: Let me guess, Blake threw another fit, right? Well, Marshall said that he refuses to work with Blake if he doesn't show more respect for his work. So I guess Marshall is out. This is all Blake's fault!
0.1: Whatever. I'll just get him a hat for the stupid event. If he refuses this time, then I quit. Simple as that.

yes.0: Could you get #b70 Fedoras#k from Male Mannequins for Blake? I don't think he'll look good in the fedora, but I just don't care at this point. Let him be.

no.0: Could you help me out one last time? I promise I won't ask for more help if Blake still refuses.

1.0: Tina sent what this time? Let me see.

yes.0: A fedora? Ugh... I hate these things, but I'm sick of waiting around. I'll make it look good. Geez, does anyone around here do any real work?

npc.0: Could you get 70 Fedoras from Male Mannequins for Blake? I don't think he'll look good in the fedora, but I just don't care at this point. Let him be.

item.0: Is Tina not done with the preparations yet? Ugh, does she want me to do this autograph event or not?
